answer: Each epoch the network randomly fuses two identities for one reward claim, like climbers roped for a summit push. Both submit passing answers to the same seed words, graded on substance AND mutual distinctness by independents. One operator running both ends must produce two genuinely different reasonings under side-by-side comparison -- a single mind cannot fake two. Honest pairs diverge naturally: the copper of independent thought shines while cloned pairs tarnish. Farming gains nothing -- each puppet costs double genuine work, and any umber-stained collusion in a pair burns both claims.
